author: stephanlivera
title: Claude motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @stephanlivera. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: An editorial identity turns a collection of motion demonstrations into one authored film: the coral radial mark, cream/ink contrast and tiny registration furniture recur while the main visual language changes radically.
chapter_map: A tiny coral seed grows into a many-spoke symbol, with concentric hairlines and ticks providing a stable scale reference.
A cream/coral radial expansion fills the frame and reveals a huge black wordmark; a small italic serif role line makes the heavy sans feel editorial.
An oblique cream wipe and flying letter fragments resolve into six horizontal easing demonstrations. Dots share endpoints but use visibly different intermediate spacing.
Cobalt replaces cream. A centre-aligned disc becomes a triangle and star, with thin nested outlines and small orbiting satellite shapes.
A square introduces a dense cream squiggle tessellation on ink. A moving coral region changes selected cells; the field collapses towards the next spatial study.
A sparse three-dimensional point surface bends from a wave into a closed sphere/torus-like volume. Depth comes from projected spacing, scale and brightness rather than a solid mesh.
Oversized rapid typography alternates black, cream, cobalt and acid-yellow fields. Outline repetitions and motion smears distinguish sustained text from impact frames.
The radial mark returns beside the wordmark on coral. Residual specks dissipate while the main lockup holds.

author: ajith_io
title: Abstract motion design reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @ajith_io. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: One coral dot acts as a narrative carrier across type, geometry, point fields, dimensional ribbons and circular text; the ending recovers the same dot as the wordmark punctuation.
chapter_map: A centred dot duplicates into a ring, establishing the seed and radial repetition before any title appears.
A circular coral matte grows into a full field. Heavy black words arrive in staggered groups with registration brackets and rapid lateral smears, then reduce back to a dot.
A circle, rotated rounded square and yellow triangle appear inside selection-style bounding boxes with handles. A small radial patterned rosette follows.
On cream, a regular dot lattice deforms around a moving wave of coral accents, maintaining enough row structure for the displacement to be legible.
The same particle vocabulary is projected onto a cobalt wave, sphere and torus; a wire cube changes the silhouette before the next cut.
A striped multicolour tube sweeps over yellow, curling around empty space. Parallel bands, dark edging and highlight shading provide a dimensional material cue.
Horizontal bands of spaced capitals bend into concentric typographic rings around the coral seed, then blur/compress towards the centre.
A cream circular expansion reveals a restrained serif name with coral punctuation; the final role line holds beneath it.

author: himanshutwtxs
title: Motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @himanshutwtxs. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: The film makes animation mechanics visible: annotated bounces, spacing diagrams, keyframe furniture and exaggerated word behaviour explain craft while demonstrating it.
chapter_map: A blue ball follows a visible arc onto a baseline, with ghost positions exposing spacing, changing velocity and squash at impact.
Tall condensed title characters rise from below the baseline at different times, bend/overshoot, then settle into a readable two-line block with blue punctuation.
Large single-word cards demonstrate different behaviours: vertical bounce, horizontal stretch, spin and an intentionally abrupt red snap. Dark backgrounds sharpen the silhouettes.
The field turns white for a position-versus-time diagram and a moving square; a linear line is replaced with a curved trajectory while ghost squares illustrate spacing.
A dotted dark field carries a blue chain and red accents. The chain curves and follows through, then the supporting plane tilts in perspective.
A blue centre with concentric rings and small symbols builds an anticipation/progress study; outer elements orbit while the percentage-like label advances.
A radial white expansion returns to the light field. Condensed closing words arrive with stagger and overshoot, then hold with blue punctuation.

author: ultimaxbt
title: Orange dot motion system
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 and HTML by @ultimaxbt. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A single orange dot links an accessibility-toggle joke, typography, spring mechanics, shape transformations, a dimensional type ring and a halftone field. The return to the opening composition makes this an intentional loop.
chapter_map: A large orange toggle and cursor pull back to expose a reduced-motion label; the UI gesture becomes a visual premise rather than a lengthy product demo.
The main word resolves on cream. The orange dot travels over its letterforms and generates short directional smears.
A position graph shows an overshoot and damped settling. The final orange point and axis enlarge into the next shape.
The centre alternates circle, rotated rounded square and pill while cream, orange and black exchange foreground/background roles.
A white band of type wraps around the orange centre in perspective, with its rear half dimmer and visibly reversed.
A regular black dot field expands radially around the orange point, then contracts, using variable dot radius rather than arbitrary particle motion.
A clean black credentials card holds; the orange zero and punctuation act as hierarchy cues.
A quick type-ring/graph recap returns to the cream title and original toggle composition.

author: jasonzhou1993
title: Claude motion reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @jasonzhou1993. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: The reel moves from concrete animation principles into geometric fields, particle typography, spatial point volumes, a graphic performance panel and an elegant ribbon-backed closing statement.
chapter_map: An orange ball bounces above a thin ground line on black; small framing marks establish a technical identity.
Large principle words alternate orange, black, cream and blue. Individual letters arrive with different timing; faint outline repetitions form a background texture.
Staggered vertical strips uncover a field of rotating squares arranged in expanding rings, with orange cells mixed among dimmer neutral cells.
Loose particles converge into a readable word, retaining colour variation across the letters rather than becoming a solid text mask.
A particle sphere floats above a perspective floor, then deforms into ring-like volumes with dark blue, coral and white accents.
A rising curtain of coloured vertical bars introduces a cream dashboard. Large figures, bars and a line chart animate independently but share an alignment grid.
Horizontal strips reveal translucent orange/violet ribbons behind a large italic serif phrase. A brief horizontal breakup begins the exit.
A compact lowercase name and orange punctuation resolve on black, with a small role line and ample negative space.

author: ismailfahmi
title: Drone Emprit showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @ismailfahmi. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A continuous luminous particle mass tells a data-intelligence story by changing topology: flowing sheet, coloured clusters, network map, temporal spike and finally a brand title.
chapter_map: A brief brand title on deep blue gives way to a white flowing particle surface.
The luminous sheet folds and twists while a restrained bottom caption and small top-right counter supply narrative context.
Cyan, yellow and pink enter the moving mass, and small platform-like labels appear around it.
The mass separates into coloured clusters and a connected network with brighter hubs. Thin connections make relationships visible without a solid object.
The network reconfigures into a temporal peak with a horizontal footprint; the middle rise becomes the dominant silhouette.
Particles gather into a compressed vortex/stripe, preparing a title-shaped arrangement.
A cyan-to-yellow brand title resolves and holds over the same navy field, surrounded by a faint residual particle halo.

author: tequilafunks
title: Claude motion design reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 and Remotion by @tequilafunks. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A graph-editor opening earns a progression from flat typography through modular pattern into an isometric tile world, then releases that structure into particles before a typographic close.
chapter_map: An orange animation curve is drawn on a sparse graph; its control handles and moving point make the motion-design premise explicit.
An orange iris reveals a heavy title. A short channel-offset glitch introduces the second word over an outline-text wallpaper.
Horizontal colour strips reveal a dense quarter-circle tile pattern. Cells rotate and then simplify into a square mosaic.
The same mosaic tips into an isometric floor and grows blocks vertically; a circular boundary and central extrusion establish a small architectural world.
The tile world recedes to a small object, then turns into a bright particle cluster, a curling flow and a coherent point sphere.
Brief large word cards demonstrate weight, width, spacing and flipping, changing the letterform behaviour rather than only its location.
A cream heavy wordmark resolves on black, with an orange dot, contrasting italic serif role and low-contrast production furniture.

author: sudo_kiran
title: Claude motion design showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @sudo_kiran. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A vivid multicolour identity is controlled by a recurring orbital mark and a consistent technical frame, while the film moves between kinetic type, a deforming shape matrix, a fluid gradient blob, point volumes and a small dashboard.
chapter_map: Coloured rings and radial ticks organise themselves around a cream seed on a dark field.
A coral expansion introduces large short words, followed by black and lime fields. Stagger, echo outlines and brief channel offsets give each word an impact.
An oblique lime strip opens onto a regular matrix of coloured circles and rounded squares. Scale and shape vary radially across the grid.
A cream iris frames a soft multicolour blob. A large neutral word overlaps the blob and its exterior; thin contour rings reinforce the silhouette.
A reverse radial transition exposes a rainbow point sphere, then a stretched plane/volume, with faint outline typography behind it.
Cream carries a compact arrangement of coloured charts and controls; count-up and drawing motions establish a UI/data-design passage.
Fast large-word cards and an iris create the climax, using lime and white rather than sustaining the whole dashboard.
The orbital mark and cream name resolve on black, with a fine coral rule and smaller role line.

author: lukasersil
title: Motion techniques showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @lukasersil. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A material journey moves from a luminous point and sliced type into primary-colour geometry, glossy three-dimensional objects, liquid marbling and particle swirls; the closing symbols recover the original simple shapes.
chapter_map: A bright horizontal flare reveals a dotted word and then stretches into a thin luminous line on black.
Large cream letters are divided into horizontal bands, with alternating offsets producing a precise sliced-text distortion.
Primary-colour strips uncover a circle, square and triangle on cream. They reorder, briefly sit before a modular pattern, and return to a clean row.
The same shapes become shaded three-dimensional objects on a dark reflective floor. A glossy organic black form follows, with blue, red and yellow light reflections.
A marbled fluid colour field expands behind large outlined typography, then fills the screen with high-contrast metallic-looking folds.
The fluid field bursts into depth-stretched particles, then forms a multicolour swirling arrangement that converges into a readable word.
The word distorts in width and letter pose; brief callbacks to particles and the glossy object return to the original flare.
A cream iris reveals a strong title with three small primary shapes above it; the final frames contract back into the luminous point.

author: gizakdag
title: Overthinking motion study
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @gizakdag. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A vertical maximalist collage uses visual overload to embody an overthinking theme, then earns relief with a sparse circular closing emblem. It is a deliberate stylistic contrast to the Swiss/technical reels.
chapter_map: A tiny central point and minimal sentence sit in a dark vertical field before a sharp yellow/white star expands.
Concentric gold rings and rotating fragments of type accumulate around a shared centre, becoming a dense orbital thought diagram.
A symmetrical collage combines a face, flowers, geometric wireforms, rainbow beams and large outlined title fragments. Repeated overlays intensify the composition.
A depth road, stylised buildings, a large eye/star and a glowing keyboard create successive surreal spatial tableaux.
A domestic/space collage breaks into a multi-panel poster grid; repeated headline wallpaper and channel offsets create the peak density.
The picture clears to black, then a circular crop recalls the collage as an emblem with a small italic instruction and a widely spaced closing title.

author: ayushunleashed
title: Claude motion design showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @ayushunleashed. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A technical progression from point to line to plane provides an unusually clear bridge between typography, projected particle geometry, data-like rhythm and a compact style montage.
chapter_map: A small orange point becomes a horizontal line across a dark dotted workspace.
The line expands into a red/orange grid plane, which tilts and rotates towards an edge-on sliver.
A pale flash and circular framing reveal a huge cream name. Solid, outline and orange states demonstrate hierarchy before the letters separate around a particle seed.
The seed becomes a point sphere with orbital ellipses, changing rotation while technical annotations stay outside the silhouette.
A large numeric tempo-style display and bar field build in a left-number/right-graphic layout; one red bar provides emphasis.
A brisk style sampler shows a Swiss number card, halftone portrait-like form, isometric blocks, channel glitch and repeated condensed typography.
On a circular construction grid, an orange disc deforms into a starburst and organic lobed shape.
A name and orange punctuation assemble on black, with a subtle warm glow and several small supporting lines.

author: hanifproduktif
title: Motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @hanifproduktif. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A compact typographic principles reel assigns different motion behaviour to each word, then uses a shape study and particle reassembly to recover the opening identity.
chapter_map: A fine lime line and seed expand through a cream iris into the main title with a lime underline.
An anticipation word on black prepares a lateral exit; an orange target-marked card demonstrates overshoot and settling.
A lime word visibly changes width, followed by cream individual characters arriving at different positions before forming a coherent word.
Weight is suggested by a compressed baseline and a heavier word on black; a thin horizontal lime cut visibly splits the next word.
An orange outlined shape morphs between circle, star and polygon over a dotted field. Individual letters then orbit on a circular path.
Short cards contrast blurred movement, channel-offset snap, eased motion and large cream typography, with a few faster intermediary cards visible in transition windows.
A particle field gathers into the final title; solid cream type and lime punctuation replace the noisy assembly for a readable hold.

author: eyishazyer
title: Motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @eyishazyer. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A countdown and identity card lead into a colourful rhythm matrix, luminous dimensional curves, topographic lines and a data panel; a rapid principles montage precedes the final signature.
chapter_map: Huge lime countdown figures and an orange bouncing seed create anticipation on a dark technical field.
A pale radial flash reveals heavy identity type with red/blue offset edges and a small orange circular badge.
Horizontal strips reveal a regular cell grid. Bright circles and squares form an annular moving region while dim outline cells remain as spatial reference.
A square portal opens into pink/cyan spatial loops on violet, changing camera angle and apparent depth without adding a solid surface.
A diagonal multicolour wipe exposes thin black topographic waves on orange, with a cream disc behind them.
Vertical strips reveal a cream information layout with a bar chart, ring indicator, line and large figures.
Fast principle cards alternate lime, black, orange, violet and pink, with words changing pose and scale.
An orange curved mark and lime dot accompany a cream wordmark on a dark violet field, followed by a fine underline.

author: blue_clarity
title: Particle sphere motion reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @blue_clarity. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A precise motion-lab identity carries a clear route from bounce spacing to condensed typography, shape topology, particle typography, an orbital sphere and a wall of miniature motion studies.
chapter_map: An orange ball bounces on light grey with ghost positions, axes and a small curve preview showing its spacing.
An orange radial fill introduces a stacked condensed phrase. A cobalt lower strip carries a contrasting cream word and separates the hierarchy into two planes.
Black/navy supports a white disc, rotated square, triangle and star. Visible path vertices and outline echoes present the shapes as designed geometry.
A central particle burst opens onto cobalt, circulates into a swirling mass and converges into a large condensed particle word above a yellow rule.
A stepped wipe reveals a point sphere with thin coloured orbital ellipses, then the volume changes orientation and compresses.
A light field reveals a nine-cell grid of small motion demonstrations, including lines, bars, arcs, bounce and a curve.
One cell enlarges to a dark field, then condensed cream branding and three short accent rules assemble and hold.

author: RaphaelAubryy
title: Motion designer résumé reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @RaphaelAubryy. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A quieter coral/cream system uses reductions and shared geometry to connect a simple title, shape morphs, pixel typography, particles, merging blobs, repeated text and a rotating labelled cube.
chapter_map: A horizontal rule grows on cream; two title lines stack across the same baseline and scale into the next view.
A coral circle becomes a diamond, triangle and rounded star on black, surrounded by faint concentric construction circles.
The star gives way to a regular cell grid. A circular black region exposes a large coral numerical mark formed from cells.
The cellular mark dissolves into particles, which gather into a large word, with the dark field keeping the small points legible.
Cream circles on coral orbit, merge through soft bridges and separate again, demonstrating a metaball-like shape language.
A cream wallpaper of repeated design words slides beneath a coral central title bar; the bar and surrounding text collapse into a smaller three-dimensional object.
A cube rotates slowly, with cream, coral and black faces carrying different motion-related labels.
A compact name/numerical lockup settles on black.

author: arjunsh1607
title: Pixelup Labs studio showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @arjunsh1607. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A studio portfolio reel uses typographic windows, fast project samples, perspective mockup fields and a restrained proof/identity close. Its relevance is motion presentation and camera continuity rather than abstract shape experimentation.
chapter_map: A tiny blue selected rectangle grows into a full blue stage with subtle alignment guides.
A large thin-to-regular brand-category word acts as a window onto glossy green imagery, then the camera passes through the lettering.
Brief identity examples occupy the full frame, including a glowing green mark, a landscape-led design and smaller framed brand cards.
A field of website mockups tilts in perspective beneath a large white category label, then the camera chooses individual laptop views.
Clean laptop/device views on light grounds alternate with a sparse category title on black.
A row of phone mockups slides into a multi-column portfolio wall, creating rhythm through offset arrivals and different image heights.
A text-and-figures claim card stays on black with blue emphasis and thin dividing rules.
The claim layout scales away to a small seed; the studio mark and name settle against a restrained blue glow.

author: codeSTACKr
title: Claude motion reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @codeSTACKr. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: Technical framing, orange punctuation and a seed/ring identity join a remarkably varied sequence of type statements, deforming lattices, orbital type and a clear easing comparison.
chapter_map: A small orange dot/ring becomes three points, then a cream horizontal band grows around emerging identity letters.
A rapid sequence of orange, black, cream and cobalt word cards uses scale, per-letter arrangement, outline repeats and a frame-count-style number.
A regular grid of small cream circles/squares pulses and rotates around orange accent cells, maintaining indexed positions as shapes change.
The grid contracts to a seed, becomes a point sphere with a bright blue core and orange orbital type, then stretches into a vertical helix.
A cream graphic shows a curve editor at left and multiple dot lanes at right, with orange/black endpoints revealing different spacing laws.
A short typography montage contrasts huge orange/cream words, italic serif text and an orange infinity-like loop.
The sun/ring mark sits above a heavy cream name, with a small italic role and restrained lime availability badge.

author: samuel_spitz
title: Motion design showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @samuel_spitz. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A coral line and cream/ink system introduce modular geometry, then a plane-to-chrome material transformation becomes the central spectacle before a restrained editorial ending.
chapter_map: An orange seed traces a line and underlines a heavy cream word on black; an orange letter becomes a transition carrier.
A cream iris reveals a small grid of circles, squares, arches and quarter-circles. Individual modules flip around vertical axes with phased timing.
A cobalt stage contains a dark graphic plane with a serif depth word and orange wave; multiple wireframe planes separate in perspective, then the camera enlarges the graphic plane.
A chrome sphere occupies a dark rippled material field. Strong white reflections, a warm rim and orbital curves establish gloss and depth.
An orange oblique shape covers the material, followed by quick colour, outline-text and chrome-filled letter cards.
A long coral flourish draws under a heavy cream reel title and orange date accent; a small italic line supplies a quiet secondary voice.

author: zheke
title: Kinetic type showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @zheke. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A square-format typographic self-introduction treats capability words as demonstrations, using one orange punctuation dot to connect tall type, perspective rings, glossy forms, particles and a rapid reprise.
chapter_map: Very large condensed greeting and model-name blocks alternate black and cream; the orange dot bounces between punctuation and an independent seed.
A repeated small lead-in anchors cards demonstrating squash, stretch, stagger and overshoot. Word proportions and letter arrival order change visibly.
A blur word gives way to a rotating perspective text ring on orange, then glossy orange spheres on cobalt demonstrate a material change.
An orange particle word releases into a swarm; a large transparent lens-like form distorts type and a colourful cloud backdrop.
An isometric block assembly and nested geometric tunnel create a short spatial acceleration, followed by brief callbacks to earlier techniques.
Two crossed-out tool/workflow cards are graphic claims, using one thick orange diagonal as a repeated gesture.
A compact code-themed statement and final tall numerical/name lockup return to black, cream and the orange dot.

author: influencer_seo
title: fal motion design showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @influencer_seo. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A purple/black media-platform film unifies product imagery and large type with metallic/luminous material, consistent chapter numbering and a restrained white closing brand field.
chapter_map: A terminal-like prompt types into a violet field, then a narrow media strip expands into a product-image reveal.
Large media-category words alternate solid image-filled letters and outlines. Supporting numbers, rules and a waveform-like bar field create a repeatable chapter system.
Dimensional chrome-like lettering turns into an angled wall of generated-looking imagery, with a small editorial sentence above it.
A dancer/image and a large count form a split layout; a car image and oversized multiplier follow as a second proof-style composition.
A portrait and monospaced digital count provide another claim card before a prompt-to-output demonstration.
A compact input panel sits beside a grid that fills with a luminous fish image; a layered purple radial mask compresses the image into a brand symbol.
A small violet symbol and a clear supporting sentence hold on white.

author: ndhabarde11
title: Motion designer portrait showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @ndhabarde11. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A portrait showreel preserves technical framing while scaling a familiar graphic vocabulary vertically: editorial type, shape rows, point volumes, liquid material badges and a compact data card.
chapter_map: A tiny warm seed and baseline introduce a compact name/italic greeting on black, then an orange expansion fills the portrait frame.
Large words, outline wallpaper and an italic connector alternate black, orange and white; a multi-row text wall briefly supplies density.
Cobalt carries a tall matrix of circles, squares and small star-like forms, with orange/pink accents propagating through the rows.
The matrix reduces to a bright warm seed, releases particles and briefly forms a large particle word.
A point sphere changes into lobed/ring-like spatial forms, followed by a directional particle rush.
A dense poster combines repeated typography, orange radial marks and glossy fluid/iridescent objects on black.
A white card appears on orange with count-up typography, bars and small controls; a calm baseline transition removes it.
The heavy name returns on black with an orange punctuation loop and small supporting chips.

author: _topi_003
title: Kinetic type motion showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @_topi_003. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A condensed editorial identity turns red circular letterforms into portals, carries a blue shape lattice into three-dimensional particles and uses a controlled high-speed typography/pattern climax.
chapter_map: A small radial seed enlarges into orange, revealing a condensed greeting with a thin underline and technical microtype.
A cream field carries an exceptionally large word whose red circular letters are both type and shapes; fine outline repetitions extend behind it.
One circular letter becomes a blue portal onto a regular grid of circles, diamonds, crosses and radial dashes, with sparse accent cells.
A black radial opening compresses the grid into a point sphere and then more complex orbital/looping spatial structures.
A rapid montage contrasts large red type, lime halftone, multicolour words on striped borders and repeated time-themed type.
A bright reset exposes a swirling particle field, which converges into a tall particle word inside fine circular rings.
Solid condensed cream type, orange underline and a small set of primary shapes create a readable closing lockup; the very end reduces towards the seed.

author: rendesr
title: Claude motion design showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @rendesr. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A small ball and bold statement introduce a tour of procedural shape fields, vector flow, point topology, playful physical character and optical pattern, all controlled by a narrow palette and technical frame.
chapter_map: An orange ball follows a visible bounce arc over a fine baseline and then grows into an orange field.
A heavy three-line statement builds with an off-white final word, then a stepped cream wipe covers it.
A central circle changes to square, triangle, star and rounded rosette, surrounded by a radial grid of related small shapes.
The light field flips to black and the grid becomes directional line segments. Their orientations form a wave field and briefly suggest striped outline lettering.
A point grid becomes a sphere, torus and infinity-like volume, then a blue circular expansion introduces a ring of lime seeds.
The seeds converge into a glossy lime ball that bounces and briefly carries a face, using squash and a soft grounded shadow.
A quick optical montage alternates halftone type, radial checker distortion, striped masks and an isometric cube tessellation.
Large mixed-case cream branding with orange punctuation resolves on black.

author: MisbahSy
title: LiteLLM promo reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @MisbahSy. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A violet technical product film turns many scattered interfaces into one routing system, then alternates dark diagrams and a light code scene before a large-statistics close.
chapter_map: Small API/code chips float around a central numeric headline on a dark violet field.
A glowing square and radial ticks focus the scattered system into a very large short headline.
The camera passes through a letter counter to reveal a central routing node with input and output columns linked by curved lines.
A light card expands into a cream code layout; a large two-line claim at left balances a code window at right and a strip of small provider labels below.
Staggered vertical strips return to a dark failure/rerouting diagram, with red and green states differentiating branches.
A large violet field presents three numeric claims in rows, each paired with a smaller explanation.
The statistics collapse to a horizontal light line; a logo/name resolves on dark violet with a small supporting line.

author: motiondsgnr
title: Bold typographic motion showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @motiondsgnr. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: The reel organises a broad capability tour with clear chapter framing, alternating type, particle topology, geometric morphs, fluid silhouette, concentric type, data cards and a closing wall of its own scenes.
chapter_map: An orange line grows into a full orange card with heavy black title type.
A blue iris introduces a stacked cream/yellow statement over faint outline-text wallpaper.
A diagonal wipe exposes a particle sphere that reorganises into a word and then disperses towards a light field.
A central square and triangle turn within circular construction paths; a yellow field then introduces a blue fluid blob behind large type.
The blob gives way to multiple concentric text rings, with different radii, weights and colours, changing zoom and angular phase.
Three vertical data cards on cream demonstrate bars, an easing curve and a circular numeric indicator.
A coloured topographic line field bends on black, then splits into horizontal strips.
A wall of earlier scenes serves as a dense recap, recedes in depth, and resolves into a cream brand name with a few coloured geometric accents.

author: Astrodevil_
title: Studio1 intro showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @Astrodevil_. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: An orange/ink agency film builds confidence through a consistent type and data hierarchy, using bright diagonals and exposure-like resets to connect claims rather than relying on constant geometric spectacle.
chapter_map: A compact terminal window types a launch command and checklist-like lines on a dark warm field.
A large left-aligned proposition builds line by line; the final phrase changes to orange and receives an underline.
A diagonal orange sweep introduces a large count and rising line chart, with small supporting claim chips.
A bright reset moves to an orange star and another growing figure; small square cells gather above the number.
Further proof-style cards contrast orange and black, using large numerals, a circular badge and a search-field-like element.
A short capability montage alternates solid and outline oversized words over subtle repeated star geometry.
Rows of client-like names move behind a prominent lower numeric claim, producing density while keeping one foreground hierarchy.
The final studio name builds on black with a warm halo, orange numeral and thin horizontal rule.

author: manuelogomigo
title: Flowdrive motion showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @manuelogomigo. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: An elegant serif product film uses one orange dotted file/seed system to connect upload, layered media, global delivery, a secure-domain UI, an infinity-like particle flow and a final mark.
chapter_map: A dotted ring becomes an orange file/play icon, then enters a small upload zone on white.
A large serif upload statement sits above a dotted progress bar that fills and becomes a solid rounded orange line.
The bar expands into orange strips and a dark chapter with layered perspective media planes and a warm particle cloud.
Particles settle into an orange point globe beside a large serif delivery statement; thin arcs and bright hubs suggest connections.
A light vertical wipe reveals a domain/address pill and a restrained hierarchy of security-like chips.
An orange disc expands into a full orange field, where points trace an infinity-like flowing path above a serif statement.
Offset light strips reveal a small website/portfolio view beside an editorial heading; the whole view dissolves towards a small seed.
Dotted rings surround an orange rounded-square logo; the final name and supporting line hold on white.

author: Web3Wesley
title: Type, form, space showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @Web3Wesley. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A résumé-like editorial card establishes four visual themes, then the film demonstrates type, form, space and time through a particularly coherent flat-grid-to-extruded-world transformation.
chapter_map: A cream editorial card rotates/settles into view, with a large serif name at left and ruled capability rows at right.
An orange radial wipe introduces huge black display type, outline echoes and a cream italic serif variant with a bold dimensional-looking black shadow.
A cream field and bold form word break into colourful modular circles, arcs, squares and triangles arranged on a precise grid.
The grid tilts into perspective and extrudes into coloured geometric solids. An orange ball moves among different heights, making the spatial change tangible.
A radial orange transition exposes a dark particle field that gathers into a word and then becomes curling orange/cream orbital ribbons.
The original editorial card returns, with a small orange punctuation dot and a restrained availability-style accent.

author: reflex_cloud
title: Reflex brand motion reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @reflex_cloud. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A monochrome/violet brand film links seeing, interpreting and acting through an eye, a simplified path diagram, a depth corridor of image planes, spectral colour studies and individual expressive letterforms.
chapter_map: A photographic iris fills the frame with a bracketed pupil and small technical label; its aperture changes before the camera moves inward.
Black/white title cards alternate serif and broad letter treatments, with a short phrase assembling character by character.
A circle and square are joined by an initially looping line that straightens, turning a complex route into a direct connection.
The endpoint becomes an angled image plane among many frames in a depth corridor; camera travel, roll and sequential planes imply large spatial extent.
Red, yellow, green, cyan and blue fields carry sinusoidal curves and a narrow spectral indicator, providing a deliberate colour-study interval.
Individual serif letters appear in several treatments: blur, point sampling, concentric outline and irregular solid form.
A small serif wordmark and bracketed symbol settle on black, with violet orbital framing and a restrained supporting line.

author: andginja
title: Studio website showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @andginja. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A studio film uses an elegant monogram as an image window, then connects location imagery, project cards, a website build and claim graphics with a calm blue/teal editorial identity.
chapter_map: A tiny light draws a thin monogram outline, which fills with warm imagery and enlarges into a location scene.
A large left-aligned sentence builds over a sunset photograph while additional narrow image panels slide in from the right.
Muted vertical colour strips reveal a short title and a sequence of numbered image/project cards, with portrait imagery balanced against dark text columns.
A light grid stage frames an emerging browser-style website panel next to a short editorial proposition.
The website tilts into perspective and gives way to a large count and two-column proof-style cards.
Vertical blurred image strips clear into a dark teal studio statement, combining solid sans and italic serif text.
The monogram returns above a compact name and small call-to-action-style button.

author: m1n9_k7
title: Kinetic type and particle showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @m1n9_k7. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A neutral technical frame supports an ambitious material progression: restrained point/line, headline rhythm, deforming cells, a particle sphere/torus, glossy fluid form and a typographic optical climax.
chapter_map: A small pale ball, ellipse and line establish a sparse motion-lab setting before the line expands into a coloured field.
Short large words alternate orange, black, cream and cobalt; one italic blue serif connector creates an editorial pause.
A white cell lattice on black rotates and changes shape in a wave, then gains warm accent colours around a central region.
Blue grows through the grid; a point sphere becomes a torus and a floating wave surface, with a tiny axis marker outside the form.
Cream frames a multicolour glossy blob over large italic lettering; highlights move with the surface and small rounded protrusions suggest fluid merging.
A black iris opens onto particles that gather into a heavy word and release through a nested rectangular tunnel.
Halftone rings, a large tempo-like figure, radial stripes, a channel-offset word and repeated text form a rapid montage.
A heavy cream name, orange punctuation and italic role line hold on black.

author: levabashidze
title: Swiss-style motion showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @levabashidze. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A Swiss-inspired warm graphic system demonstrates motion mechanics, restrained geometric morphs, an isometric tile wave, squiggle tessellation and editorial type before a render-progress metaphor closes the loop.
chapter_map: An orange bouncing ball follows visible ghost arcs and a measurement-like baseline on black.
An orange expansion reveals a left-aligned easing statement paired with a small curve editor; an italic serif line changes the typographic rhythm.
Cream carries a central circle, blue rounded diamond and orange star with thin concentric silhouette echoes, followed by an isometric cube.
The cube reduces into a large isometric tile plane. Heights propagate in rings, with orange cells identifying the moving wave.
The plane moves front-on and becomes a cream/black squiggle tessellation; selected orange regions provide a secondary wave.
Repeated cream/orange type scrolls over black, then a large circular letter counter opens into cobalt.
A large progress percentage grows on blue above a miniature strip of earlier scenes.
A light horizontal wipe reveals a wide mixed-case black name on cream with orange punctuation and small editorial details.

author: zaqailo
title: Motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @zaqailo. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A clean editorial opening becomes a modular colour field, then a particle volume, triangulated mesh, smooth fluid body and typography/audio-themed closing sequence—an explicit progression through representations of form.
chapter_map: A warm horizontal line and technical grid establish an axis, then a layered orange/cream radial expansion fills the screen.
A heavy black word on cream gains a red initial and large outline echoes; its circular counter contains the incoming pattern.
The camera passes through the counter into a colourful grid of geometric tiles; columns flip and the whole field breaks apart towards a seed.
A warm particle cloud forms an annular volume, curls into several lobes and settles into a bright sphere.
A low-poly sphere separates into triangular facets around a luminous core, then reassembles into a spiked solid and a smoother shaded sphere.
The smooth warm/cool sphere splits into merging fluid bodies with small satellites, then grows to cover the frame.
Short type cards contrast construction geometry, staggered animation, serif typography, a bar/sound-like display and code-like text.
Concentric orange/cream rings introduce a heavy cream name and small role line on a dark technical grid.

author: CrazyAlphaaa
title: Claude motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @CrazyAlphaaa. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A deliberately textured technical reel mixes saturated title cards, a shape matrix, an easing comparison, polygonal depth, particles and a posterised fluid blob before returning to a ring-and-name identity.
chapter_map: A warm seed drops onto a line in a grainy dark field; concentric circles and a bright reset establish scale.
Orange, cobalt, lime and magenta headline cards alternate, with outline wallpaper and short directional word arrivals.
A cobalt field carries a large regular matrix that rotates between square and circle states, with lime and orange accent cells.
A dark curve-editor diagram compares several moving dot lanes; a radial/semicircular wipe introduces a new depth section.
Nested coloured polygons create a rotating tunnel, followed by a point volume inside the same framing.
A pink/red fluid blob deforms and divides. Broad flat highlight regions give it a posterised material rather than photoreal chrome.
The blob reduces to an orange disc; a wide cream name, orbital rings and small supporting lines resolve on black.

author: fionntobin
title: Blue editorial motion showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @fionntobin. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A strict cobalt/cream editorial system demonstrates how a film can feel sophisticated through counts, grids, typography and transformations without a broad palette or continuous neon spectacle.
chapter_map: A blue square multiplies into increasingly dense square arrays, paired with large serif figures on cream.
A cobalt field carries a composition of condensed sans, italic serif and large bold text, with words arriving in different positions and hierarchies.
Cream presents a large tempo-style figure above a sparse bar/step diagram; successive blue bars and small marked points establish a time-based graphic.
A minimal blue running pictogram crosses a baseline and hurdles, using recognisable changing poses rather than a narrative scene.
The baseline becomes an isometric grid with rising blue cells, then rotates front-on into a regular square array and circular dot field.
Increasing dot density creates a halftone optical field with large overlapping circular waves.
A branching grid of small graphic choices is connected by thin lines to a selected large geometric symbol.
Cream returns with a very large elegant blue serif name along the lower field and restrained explanatory text above.

author: itsuki_dev
title: Kinetic type showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @itsuki_dev. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A confident graphic system changes between oversized type, a constructed shape study, quarter-circle tessellation, particles, a rotating depth tunnel and fine mathematical line art, with consistent orange/blue identity cues.
chapter_map: A pale seed, circle and horizontal orange line set a centre before the line expands into orange.
Large words alternate orange, blue, black and pale violet, with outline repetitions, selective yellow emphasis and brief slice/glitch departures.
A central orange square becomes triangle, star and polygon inside circular construction paths, with a small easing-like graph at right.
The shape grows into a dense quarter-circle tile field. Cell rotations create local pattern changes while the regular grid remains visible.
A diagonal wipe exposes particles forming a numerical word, which bursts into depth and a nested rectangle tunnel.
The camera moves through rotating wire rectangles with a deep blue centre and thin coloured lines.
Stepped blocks reveal a yellow editorial card with an italic serif phrase and a thin looping line sculpture.
Coloured stepped fields recede into a quiet cream wordmark and orange punctuation on black.

author: tolgayhickiran
title: Motion design principles reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @tolgayhickiran. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: An orbital identity introduces condensed type, a bright shape grid, a lime silhouette study, a particle galaxy, principle cards and a wireframe torus before the final name.
chapter_map: Concentric circles and coloured radial ticks rotate and simplify around a small seed on black.
A horizontal line becomes a baseline for condensed cream/orange letters; brief horizontal slicing and channel offsets create an energetic exit.
A regular matrix of circles and rounded squares fills black, with coloured rings/regions moving across cells.
The field transitions to lime and a central black square, triangle and star inside a thin orbit, with faint outline type behind it.
An iris exposes a luminous flattened particle galaxy, whose spiral/rotation is readable against a dark blue field.
Stepped vertical bars introduce short principle cards on orange, violet, lime and cream, including a bar-like rhythm graphic.
A wireframe torus/elliptical volume rotates in perspective, with orbital lines and a few coloured markers indicating depth.
A pale radial reset becomes an orange ring around a tall cream name; residual particles dissipate during the hold.

author: danilowm
title: Motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 and HyperFrames by @danilowm. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A light teal product film uses simple type, map pins, counted data and a camera move over repeated cards to demonstrate an approachable motion system rather than a high-density abstract spectacle.
chapter_map: A bold black sentence builds word by word on white, with a teal underline, small paw motif and location-pin punctuation.
A large teal/white reveal introduces a simplified map at right and explanatory title at left; pins appear in staggered clusters.
Teal stepped fields introduce a large count and a clean horizontal category-bar chart on white.
The chart dissolves into a perspective field of repeated place cards; the camera flies lower across rows.
The card field moves front-on, one card is selected and lifted, then the composition clears.
A compact search/address control types a location and changes a small category state.
A large teal form contracts into a rounded-square paw icon; the brand name and small supporting line hold beside it.

author: 3xtihor
title: Claude motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @3xtihor. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A bounce and bold title become shape construction, a regular cell field, a cylindrical tower of type, a wall of demonstrations and finally a particle-to-solid identity. The type tower is the distinctive spatial centrepiece.
chapter_map: An orange bouncing seed and ghost arcs establish timing above a fine baseline, then the seed expands into orange.
Short heavy words alternate orange and black; a large circular letter counter becomes the next portal.
Blue frames a cream square, triangle and star with selection handles and orbital satellites, then a square enlarges into a full cell grid.
The grid changes from cream rounded squares to coloured circles around a travelling region, then opens diagonally.
Multiple horizontal bands of type wrap a rotating cylinder, with coloured front faces and dim/reversed rear text.
Stepped colour fields reveal a multi-panel wall of fluid, bar, toggle, curve and tunnel studies.
The wall disperses into particles, which sweep through a torus-like form and converge into a large word.
The particle word becomes solid cream text with an orange rule, a small italic date-like accent and punctuation.

author: ghinaiya_nirmal
title: Claude motion design reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @ghinaiya_nirmal. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A highly structured technical reel connects bouncing punctuation, typographic verb cards, bounded shape morphs, moving colour bands through a dot field, spatial particles and a playful fluid/drip passage.
chapter_map: An orange seed bounces on a line, accompanied by a small timing curve near the lower-right.
Short title cards alternate orange, black, blue and cream. A red underline and red circular letter create continuity.
An orange rosette, rounded diamond, triangle and star share a selection box and layered coloured outline trails.
A dense dim dot field carries moving orange, blue and pink wave/ring regions, changing cell scale and colour with distance.
A point sphere becomes a torus and disperses into a dark cloud, then a cream iris reveals large italic type with clusters of orange and blue circles.
The circle clusters move across the italic word; a black dripping matte descends to reveal a lime flowing curve on black.
A brief montage adds coloured isometric blocks, count/bar typography, a channel-offset word and a lime donut-chart-like graphic.
A warm orange ring introduces a broad cream wordmark and small italic role on black.

author: johnsavage_ai
title: Code-only motion design reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @johnsavage_ai. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: The reel combines a motion-curve premise with heavy/italic typography, a luminous glossy object, a deforming grid, particle text, line topography and concentric typographic acceleration.
chapter_map: A pale seed and sparse axes resolve into an orange easing curve with a bright moving point.
An orange radial burst reveals a heavy title paired with a large cream italic serif word; weight and width visibly change.
The camera passes through a letter counter into a dark scene with a glossy irregular sphere, bright coloured reflections and wide background type bands.
A light field carries a dense regular grid of circles, squares and crosses, with coloured cells and a travelling deformation.
A warm radial particle burst forms a large code-themed word; the resolved point letters hold briefly.
A blue field carries many pale topographic lines that rise into a central surface.
A cream skills-style bar chart animates, using a single orange highlight among neutral bars.
Concentric type rings and radial speed lines zoom/rotate through alternating fields, then reduce to a seed.
A wide cream name and italic role return on black with orange punctuation.

author: LeonKohli
title: Geometric motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @LeonKohli. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A bright cobalt/white/lime system uses a persistent orange ball to connect type, modular geometry, an isometric tile wave, particle rings and circular numerical graphics before an unusually restrained lowercase close.
chapter_map: An orange ball bounces across a dark baseline, with ghost arcs and a small lower spacing strip.
An orange radial flash introduces a blue field with a white lowercase word, then white with black lowercase type; the dot becomes the letter's punctuation.
A small seed expands into a colourful grid of arches, quarters, circles, triangles and stripes.
The graphic grid tilts into a blue isometric tile plane with white/black/lime accents and an orange ball. Height waves propagate from its contact region.
On blue, orange shapes merge into a rosette and split into a ring of small spheres; they gather before a particle release.
A warm radial particle burst becomes a tilted annular volume and contracts to a ring.
White carries a circular numeric indicator and repeated coloured rings that recede towards a vanishing point, then darken into a ring tunnel.
A tiny word grows into a compact lowercase cream name with orange punctuation on black; the very end returns to a seed.

author: marouanegazouzi
title: Crux motion design showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @marouanegazouzi. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A dark blue editorial product film uses serif headlines, an analytical distribution, a restrained UI, radar geometry and split-flap-like lettering to communicate a sequence of propositions.
chapter_map: A luminous blue path draws a pulse-like curve and becomes a bright horizontal line.
Large cream serif statements alternate over faint outline-text wallpaper, with selected blue words and a short underline.
Small particles settle into a histogram/distribution at right, paired with a large growing count and a highlighted observation line.
A blue/white flare expands, then contracts into the product icon and a serif name.
A compact analysis interface appears beside a stacked serif list; rows and coloured multipliers reveal in sequence.
A radar-like ellipse and scanning wedge accompany a count and a rising small line chart on black.
A short large serif card is followed by individually flipping/scrambling dark letter tiles and a blue editorial statement.
A blue line wipes away the statement; the icon and serif name return with a small supporting line and URL-style pill.

author: safarkhanshuvo
title: Motion design showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @safarkhanshuvo. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A physical seed and condensed type introduce a wave-like matrix, spatial particles, a blue data chapter and a brisk set of optical/typographic contrasts before a custom geometric closing mark.
chapter_map: A pale bouncing seed changes to orange while large dim figures count in the background; a baseline and impact strokes establish physical contact.
An orange expansion reveals short condensed statements and a large moving word, with underline and slice/glitch departures.
Cream supports a grid of blue/orange circles and black squares. A travelling deformation changes shape, orientation and local density before the field turns dark.
A point sphere morphs into a torus and a condensed particle word on black.
Blue fills through the word's centre and presents a large percentage, bars and a small ring/line chart.
Short cards contrast halftone, striped speed, a softly lit gradient field, radial burst and a brief glitch.
Nested wire rectangles rotate in depth around a sequence of condensed words.
A cream reset reveals three small primary shapes arranging into an original-looking mark beside a condensed black name.

author: sahildesigner23
title: 3D motion design showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @sahildesigner23. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A restrained orange/cream/black material film turns flat typography into extruded letterforms, chrome fluid shapes, a phone render panel and an isometric tile field, then returns through a staged editor-like view to a clean final name.
chapter_map: A seed/ring introduces a thin uppercase word that gains weight, with two fine horizontal rules defining its band.
Solid cream type sits over orange outline repetitions, then the surrounding field clears.
The word gains orange extruded sides and tilts into perspective; individual letters rotate and move along a curved line.
A counter zoom reveals small chrome/cream-red fluid bodies on orange. They merge and separate before elongating into a device silhouette.
A black phone on cream shows a render-style progress panel; the camera enlarges its orange cell icon into a full tiled surface.
A dark isometric tile plane carries an orange centre and a white height ring, with contact-like waves and camera motion.
The tiled scene appears within an editor-like frame and reduces towards a seed, with charts/timeline furniture visible around it.
A cream radial expansion reveals a wide black mixed-case name, orange punctuation and small role text.

author: Grace_sunnyy
title: Keyframe motion design reel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @Grace_sunnyy. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A red diamond/keyframe identity connects a graph-editor opening, a short typographic proposition, a faceted 3D solid, particle order, dashboard panels and a set of explicitly demonstrated transitions.
chapter_map: A red diamond moves along a line that becomes a large easing curve; the bottom keyframe timeline remains visible.
Short heavy words alternate orange, black and cream, then assemble into a two-line proposition with one red word.
A red faceted solid rotates within orbital guides, explodes into triangles and reassembles into a planar diamond.
The diamond becomes a particle field, deforms in space and gathers into a large word.
A multi-panel technical composition shows a large frame-like count, type specimen, bars, curves and a tempo-like figure.
Brief cards demonstrate circular reveal, turn, glitch, wipe, spin and outline echo, using consistent type and timeline furniture.
The red diamond returns beside a heavy cream name; small particles clear and a supporting statement settles beneath it.

author: TeslaChartz
title: Motion designer showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @TeslaChartz. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A radial opening and condensed proposition lead into a clean primary-shape array, a partially wireframe torus, flat lime fluid contours, a timing comparison and a concise type/material montage.
chapter_map: A fine line/circle expands into a radial fan, then an orange circular matte fills the frame.
A red-orange title builds in condensed cream/black lines, framed by thin repeating text bands.
Horizontal strips reveal a grid of circles, crosses, squares, triangles and rings in red, blue, black and cream; the cells rotate and reorder.
A blue field frames a dimensional torus that changes from wireframe to coloured faceted solid, with small orbiting type elements.
The torus fragments and lime contour-like blobs move behind a large word on black; a lime shape expands into the next field.
A lime curve-and-dot-lanes composition demonstrates timing and spacing with clear endpoints and comparison rows.
Large type cards alternate outline letters, extruded blue dimensional lettering, repeated rhythm-like text and vertical colour bars.
A pale reset reveals a condensed cream name on black, with thin rules and small supporting copy; the very end reduces the identity.

author: Shinskinakamoto
title: Kinetic shapes showreel
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @Shinskinakamoto. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A vivid multicolour pulse identity controls kinetic type, central shape transformations, a particle swarm, point/line volumes, a clean UI panel set and a luminous topographic rhythm passage.
chapter_map: Coloured radial ticks and circles organise around a seed, revealing a cream greeting with offset lime/violet echoes.
A layered circular colour expansion introduces lime headline cards and a repeated solid/outline word wall.
Violet carries a large orange disc, square and triangle over a systematic grid of small coloured circles and rounded cells.
A black circular opening releases a multicolour particle swirl, which compresses, forms a word and bursts through depth.
A point sphere, torus and wire cube share a central axis and thin coloured orbits, with radial depth lines in the final transition.
Cream frames three staggered product/data cards with bars, a circular percentage/toggle and a line chart.
A dark iris reveals a luminous cyan/pink topographic line field beneath a large lime/cream word, followed by brief slice disruption.
Vertical coloured bands clear into a small multicolour waveform-like mark beside a wide cream name on black.

author: ik_builds
title: Paper-style product launch film
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 and HyperFrames + GSAP by @ik_builds. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A paper/annotation brand film reuses a teal bouncing seed to organise documents, a typographic proposition, a comparative curve and a clean closing mark. It broadens the study with an applied narrative built from the same motion mechanics.
chapter_map: A teal ball bounces above a baseline on warm white, with ghost positions and a handwritten annotation near its arc.
Paper-like estimates, drawings and notes enter around the ball, each with slight tilt, cast shadow and a nearby hand-drawn label.
The field becomes dark green; documents orbit towards a glowing teal centre, which briefly forms a small connected network.
Condensed cream words drop in with stagger and mild rotation, then settle into a two-line proposition and teal underline.
The letters scatter into a dark graph comparison: a jittery baseline is contrasted with a smooth rising teal curve and moving endpoint.
Alternating light strips reveal white; the seed arcs down towards a small teal mark.
The mark and a clean mixed-case name hold on cream, with a small serif supporting line and hand-drawn URL-like oval.

author: quickdesignio
title: QuickDesign brand promo
attribution: A motion video made with Claude Opus 5.5 by @quickdesignio. Copy the full prompt behind it, or customize it for your own video.
thesis: A lime/ink product film links a typed brief to an angled wall of ad cards, before/after imagery, rapid capability typography and a modular-cell-to-logo transformation.
chapter_map: A compact question types on black, with an italic lime word and a small input field that gains a URL-like value.
A dark green reset reveals an angled array of ad cards. Cells fill in staggered order while a lower serif/sans statement and counter complete the composition.
A light panel presents a muted product photo, then slides in a bright lime studio-style version with a strike-through/arrow annotation.
A phone/avatar-style panel enters beside the product card, then the scene moves into full-field typography.
Short capability words alternate lime, cream, coral and black, using masks, outlines, brief pixel breakup and a radar-like graphic.
A dark two-column statement and growth-chart card provide a clear lower-density composition.
Lime rounded cells fill the frame, reorganise into a small modular square mark and shed a few particles.
The modular mark and clean brand name hold on black, with a small italic support line and restrained circular framing.
